name: How are costs structured for full design-through-construction services?
description: Expenses are structured in phases covering planning, permitting, sitework, materials, and labor, with early estimates refined as plans develop.

mainEntity.name: How are costs structured for full design-through-construction services?

acceptedAnswer.text: Costs depend on square footage, site terrain, structural complexity, and chosen finishes. Design and engineering typically represent a percentage of the total project budget, with the remainder allocated to site work, permits, labor, and materials. A major decision factor in budget planning is site conditions; steep ground or rocky soil can increase earthwork and foundation expenses before structural framing even begins. Detailed pre-construction planning provides clear cost visibility across each phase.
